FloPlast uPVC half round guttering provides an effective and durable system for rainwater management on various building types. Manufactured from uPVC, this 112mm half-round gutter is designed for straightforward installation due to its plain-end connection and convenient 3m length. The high flow capacity ensures efficient rainwater drainage, protecting foundations and landscaping. This gutter offers peace of mind for trade professionals seeking dependable drainage solutions.
